entries.a5d21a982f7365fa: As its management policy for the eighth fiscal year of Reiwa, it sets out "responding to the new economic environment," and lists continuing a stable profitable structure, realizing a high-profit structure through challenges to new revenue, reviewing businesses from a long-term perspective, and establishing "safety and trust" through thorough legal compliance and crisis management systems. With the transportation business, including highly public fixed-route buses, as its core business, it operates real estate, merchandise sales, travel, inn and air agency businesses, and aims to realize a safe and secure society, starting with transportation safety, while valuing "ties with the local community."
